title: PenniLogic required check-name registry
description: One entry per repository of the PenniLogic organization: the native check name its generated CI workflow produces and its branch ruleset requires, the PenniLogic/infra generator commit that rendered the workflow currently on main, and the stack whose build, test and lint the workflow runs. Validated by governance/conformance/registry.py with the standard library only.

check_name.description: The status-check context the workflow produces (the job name) and the ruleset requires.

workflow_ref.description: Full commit SHA of PenniLogic/infra whose generator rendered the workflow currently on the repository's main.

language.description: Stack whose real build, test and lint the generated workflow runs: kotlin (Gradle), typescript (npm), python (unittest/pytest), documentation (docs checks) or openapi (contract lint and generated-client verification).
